Components linked by S-distances have diameter <=2RM; if two components shared a nonzero internal difference, two cross pairs would repeat a difference outside S, contradiction. Translating components by H 4^i separates cross-component difference centers and preserves the finite defect profile, yielding an explicit seed in [1,B]. Hence equivalence with finite search is logically valid. For singleton defect r>=3, three u-separated pairs force a second repeated distance via shifted starts; the r=2 progression seed works.
